name: SDM Kinematics
description: Sun Devil Motorsports suspension-kinematics tool (OptimumKinematics-class): configurable per-axle architectures (double wishbone, MacPherson strut, 5-link; pushrod/pullrod/direct/rocker-arm actuation; coil or torsion springs; third-element or heave-roll decoupling; U-bar/Z-bar ARBs) in OptimumK global coordinates, hardpoint editor, live 3D suspension with roll-center/IC overlays, Newton-Raphson position solver, heave/roll/pitch/steer sweeps, OptimumK Excel/JSON import + SDM Excel export, multi-parameter evolutionary optimizer with actuation-plane constraints, auto-generated PDF study reports, clearance motion studies, and a dynamic force calculator (G-G envelope or CSV traces) with animated link/tire force vectors. Sandboxed; declares file.write for exports.
